#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create the Project Kickoff Meeting ICS file (next Monday, 10:00-12:00)."""
import sys
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path

OUT_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "kickoff.ics"
DEFAULT_TZ = "America/New_York"

# Minimal VTIMEZONE definitions used by the manual ICS generator.
VTIMEZONE_DATA = {
    "America/New_York": (
        ("DAYLIGHT", "-0500", "-0400", "EDT", "19700308T020000",
         "FREQ=YEARLY;BYMONTH=3;BYDAY=2SU"),
        ("STANDARD", "-0400", "-0500", "EST", "19701101T020000",
         "FREQ=YEARLY;BYMONTH=11;BYDAY=1SU"),
    ),
    "America/Chicago": (
        ("DAYLIGHT", "-0600", "-0500", "CDT", "19700308T020000",
         "FREQ=YEARLY;BYMONTH=3;BYDAY=2SU"),
        ("STANDARD", "-0500", "-0600", "CST", "19701101T020000",
         "FREQ=YEARLY;BYMONTH=11;BYDAY=1SU"),
    ),
    "America/Denver": (
        ("DAYLIGHT", "-0700", "-0600", "MDT", "19700308T020000",
         "FREQ=YEARLY;BYMONTH=3;BYDAY=2SU"),
        ("STANDARD", "-0600", "-0700", "MST", "19701101T020000",
         "FREQ=YEARLY;BYMONTH=11;BYDAY=1SU"),
    ),
    "America/Los_Angeles": (
        ("DAYLIGHT", "-0800", "-0700", "PDT", "19700308T020000",
         "FREQ=YEARLY;BYMONTH=3;BYDAY=2SU"),
        ("STANDARD", "-0700", "-0800", "PST", "19701101T020000",
         "FREQ=YEARLY;BYMONTH=11;BYDAY=1SU"),
    ),
    "UTC": (
        ("STANDARD", "+0000", "+0000", "UTC", "19700101T000000", None),
    ),
}


def next_monday(now: datetime) -> datetime.date:
    """Date of the next Monday strictly after today."""
    days_ahead = (0 - now.weekday()) % 7  # Monday == 0
    if days_ahead == 0:
        days_ahead = 7
    return (now + timedelta(days=days_ahead)).date()


def build_vtimezone(tzid: str) -> list:
    lines = ["BEGIN:VTIMEZONE", f"TZID:{tzid}"]
    for kind, off_from, off_to, tzname, dtstart, rrule in VTIMEZONE_DATA[tzid]:
        lines.append(f"BEGIN:{kind}")
        lines.append(f"TZOFFSETFROM:{off_from}")
        lines.append(f"TZOFFSETTO:{off_to}")
        lines.append(f"TZNAME:{tzname}")
        lines.append(f"DTSTART:{dtstart}")
        if rrule:
            lines.append(f"RRULE:{rrule}")
        lines.append(f"END:{kind}")
    lines.append("END:VTIMEZONE")
    return lines


def generate_ics(tzid: str, start_dt: datetime, end_dt: datetime,
                 uid: str, now_utc: datetime) -> str:
    lines = [
        "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
        "VERSION:2.0",
        "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Project Kickoff//EN",
        "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
        "METHOD:PUBLISH",
    ]
    lines += build_vtimezone(tzid)
    lines += [
        "BEGIN:VEVENT",
        f"UID:{uid}",
        f"DTSTAMP:{now_utc:%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ}",
        f"DTSTART;TZID={tzid}:{start_dt:%Y%m%dT%H%M%S}",
        f"DTEND;TZID={tzid}:{end_dt:%Y%m%dT%H%M%S}",
        "SUMMARY:Project Kickoff Meeting",
        "DESCRIPTION:Project kickoff - goals, scope, and next steps.",
        "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
        "SEQUENCE:0",
        "TRANSP:OPAQUE",
        "BEGIN:VALARM",
        "ACTION:DISPLAY",
        "DESCRIPTION:Project Kickoff Meeting starts in 15 minutes",
        "TRIGGER:-PT15M",
        "END:VALARM",
        "END:VEVENT",
        "END:VCALENDAR",
        "",
    ]
    return "\r\n".join(lines)


def validate(path: Path, tzid: str, start_dt: datetime, end_dt: datetime,
             uid: str, now_utc: datetime) -> None:
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    problems = []
    for marker in ("BEGIN:VCALENDAR", "END:VCALENDAR", "BEGIN:VEVENT",
                   "END:VEVENT", "BEGIN:VTIMEZONE", "END:VTIMEZONE",
                   "BEGIN:VALARM", "END:VALARM"):
        if marker not in text:
            problems.append(f"missing {marker}")
    checks = [
        (f"UID:{uid}", "UID"),
        (f"DTSTAMP:{now_utc:%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ}", "DTSTAMP"),
        (f"DTSTART;TZID={tzid}:{start_dt:%Y%m%dT%H%M%S}", "DTSTART"),
        (f"DTEND;TZID={tzid}:{end_dt:%Y%m%dT%H%M%S}", "DTEND"),
        ("SUMMARY:Project Kickoff Meeting", "SUMMARY"),
    ]
    for needle, label in checks:
        if needle not in text:
            problems.append(f"{label} mismatch")
    if text.count("BEGIN:VTIMEZONE") != text.count("END:VTIMEZONE"):
        problems.append("VTIMEZONE unbalanced")
    if text.count("BEGIN:VEVENT") != text.count("END:VEVENT"):
        problems.append("VEVENT unbalanced")
    if problems:
        raise SystemExit("Validation failed: " + "; ".join(problems))
    print("Structural validation: OK")

    try:
        from icalendar import Calendar
        cal = Calendar.from_ical(path.read_bytes())
        events = [c for c in cal.walk() if c.name == "VEVENT"]
        if len(events) != 1:
            raise SystemExit(f"Expected 1 VEVENT, got {len(events)}")
        ev = events[0]
        delta = ev.get("dtend").dt - ev.get("dtstart").dt
        if delta != timedelta(hours=2):
            raise SystemExit(f"Unexpected duration: {delta}")
        print("icalendar parse check: OK (duration = 2 hours)")
    except ImportError:
        print("icalendar not installed; skipped full parse check")


def main() -> None:
    tzid = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else DEFAULT_TZ
    if tzid not in VTIMEZONE_DATA:
        raise SystemExit(
            f"Unsupported timezone '{tzid}'. Supported: "
            + ", ".join(sorted(VTIMEZONE_DATA))
        )

    now_local = datetime.now()
    meeting_date = next_monday(now_local)
    start_dt = datetime(meeting_date.year, meeting_date.month, meeting_date.day, 10, 0)
    end_dt = start_dt + timedelta(hours=2)
    now_utc = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    uid = f"{uuid.uuid4()}@project-kickoff"

    ics_text = generate_ics(tzid, start_dt, end_dt, uid, now_utc)
    OUT_PATH.write_bytes(ics_text.encode("utf-8"))

    validate(OUT_PATH, tzid, start_dt, end_dt, uid, now_utc)

    print(f"Created: {OUT_PATH}")
    print(f"Summary:  Project Kickoff Meeting")
    print(f"Date:     {start_dt:%A, %B %d, %Y}")
    print(f"Start:    {start_dt:%I:%M %p} ({tzid})")
    print(f"End:      {end_dt:%I:%M %p} ({tzid})")
    print(f"Duration: 2 hours")
    print(f"Reminder: 15 minutes before")
    print(f"UID:      {uid}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
